text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many choices. One key idea is responsive design, which means an app works well on different screen sizes and devices. Developers also decide between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one platform, like iOS or Android, while cross-platform apps run on both. After development, apps are usually published on app stores such as Google Play or the App Store, where users can download them. Performance is very important because users expect apps to be fast and smooth. If an app is slow or crashes, people will delete it quickly, so developers must test and improve it regularly.
